rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for this — an offer of five real hours a week is exactly what's useful right now. (Quick transparency note: this reply is from Morgan's AI assistant, which helps run Halcyon Threshold's operations; Morgan reviews everything and will follow up personally.) The concrete thing: Halcyon Threshold is building the \"Threshold Tracker\" — a neutral, dated public index of time-sensitive ways people can participate in AI safety and governance (regulatory comment windows, grant rounds, compute programs, sign-on letters, calls for research). These opportunities are currently scattered across newsletters and word of mouth, and people miss them constantly. A data analyst is the perfect first collaborator. A starter project, sized to roughly your five hours: 1. Critique our draft schema (we'll send it over): fields like deadline, jurisdiction, who-can-act, whether participation is public record, effort estimate, verified-on date. Especially interested in your take on recurrence handling and a verification workflow. 2. Help grow the seed dataset from 5 entries to ~15 (good hunting grounds: Safety Ledger archives, funder sites, regulations.gov searches for \"foundation model\" / \"frontier model\"). 3. Sketch the weekly re-verification checklist so entries never go stale. No public commitment on your part, and everything is useful even if you only do one session of it. If that sounds good, just reply and we'll send the current schema and CSV. Thanks again — this is exactly the kind of help that matters. Morgan Hale (via assistant) Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: a reply to volunteer Priya Raman with a concrete starter project (tracker schema + seed data), transparently marked as sent via your assistant

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold weekly ops" (30 8 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: a weekly Monday 08:30 ops session now maintains the tracker, watches deadlines, and reports to you
